```{r}
#############################################################
## Effects of PBM Carve-Outs on State Medicaid Program Payments 
## Methods: Synthetic Control, Staggered Difference-in-Difference
## Stratified by generic vs. brand and drug class  
#############################################################

# NOTE: All cost/reimbursement variables reflect Medicaid program payments
# (Total Amount Reimbursed from CMS SDUD), not patient out-of-pocket costs.
# Medicaid enrollees generally face zero or minimal copays.

# Table of Contents
# 1. SDUD Data
# 2. Enrollment Data
# 3. Synthetic Control - CA
# 4. DiD — CA (robustness)
# 5. Downstream Effects — CA
# 6. DiD — NY and WV
# 7. Single PBM Structure Analysis - OH
# 8. NADAC Spread Analysis 
# 9. Generic vs Brand Stratification 
# 10. Staggered DiD 
# 11. Part D Placebo 
# 12. Drug Class Heterogeneity 
# 13. Event Studies — Drug Class 
# 14. Summary of Results by Drug Class 
# 15. Event Studies - Specific Oncology Drugs

# Library 
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidysynth)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(fixest)

# ============================================
# 1. SDUD DATA 
# ============================================
process_file <- function(file) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(State != "XX") %>%
    mutate(
      qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4,
      across(c(`Number of Prescriptions`, `Total Amount Reimbursed`, `Units Reimbursed`), as.numeric)
    ) %>%
    group_by(State, qtime, Year, Quarter, `Utilization Type`) %>%
    summarise(
      rx = sum(`Number of Prescriptions`, na.rm = TRUE),
      reimbursed = sum(`Total Amount Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      units = sum(`Units Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Generate file list
sdud_files <- paste0("SDUD/StateDrugUtilizationData-", 2015:2025, ".csv")
panel_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(sdud_files, process_file))

# Merge SDUD data into panel 
panel <- panel_raw %>%
  group_by(State, qtime, Year, Quarter) %>%
  summarise(
    total_rx = sum(rx, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_reimbursed = sum(reimbursed, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_units = sum(units, na.rm = TRUE),
    ffsu_rx = sum(rx[`Utilization Type` == "FFSU"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mcou_rx = sum(rx[`Utilization Type` == "MCOU"], na.rm = TRUE),
    ffsu_share = ffsu_rx / total_rx,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 2. MEDICAID ENROLLMENT DATA
# ============================================
enrollment <- read_csv("pi-dataset-march-2026release.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

enrollment_q <- enrollment %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(`Reporting Period` %/% 100),
    Month = as.integer(`Reporting Period` %% 100),
    Quarter = ceiling(Month / 3),
    qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4
  ) %>%
  group_by(State = `State Abbreviation`, qtime) %>%
  summarise(
    enrollment = mean(`Total Medicaid and CHIP Enrollment`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge enrollment into panel 
panel <- panel %>%
  left_join(enrollment_q, by = c("State", "qtime")) %>%
  mutate(
    rx_per_enrollee = total_rx / enrollment,
    reimbursed_per_enrollee = total_reimbursed / enrollment
  )

# Medical Care Consumer Price Index (Bureau of Labor Statistics - annual averages)
# October 2005 is missing
cpi <- data.frame(
  Year = 2015:2025,
  cpi_medical = c(446.762, 463.678, 475.317, 484.704, 498.402, 518.856, 525.265, 546.551, 549.085, 563.852, 580.098)
)
cpi$deflator <- cpi$cpi_medical[cpi$Year == 2024] / cpi$cpi_medical  # constant 2024 dollars

panel <- panel %>%
  left_join(cpi %>% select(Year, deflator), by = "Year") %>%
  mutate(
    total_reimbursed = total_reimbursed * deflator
  )
```

```{r}
# ======================================================
# 3. SYNTHETIC CONTROL OF CARVE-OUT (Cost per Rx) — CA 
# ======================================================
treatment_time <- 2022.0

contaminated <- c("OH", "NY", "WV", "TN", "MO", "ND", "WI")

panel_ca <- panel %>%
  filter(!State %in% contaminated, State != "XX", State != "PR") %>%
  mutate(ffsu_share = ifelse(is.finite(ffsu_share), ffsu_share, 0))

n_periods <- n_distinct(panel_ca$qtime)
panel_ca <- panel_ca %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  filter(n() == n_periods) %>%
  ungroup()

sc_ca <- panel_ca %>%
  synthetic_control(
    outcome = ffsu_share,
    unit = State,
    time = qtime,
    i_unit = "CA",
    i_time = treatment_time,
    generate_placebos = TRUE
  ) %>%
  generate_predictor(
    time_window = c(2015, treatment_time - 0.25),
    ffsu_share = mean(ffsu_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    rx_per_enrollee = mean(rx_per_enrollee, na.rm = TRUE),
    cost_per_rx = mean(total_reimbursed / total_rx, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  generate_weights(optimization_window = c(2015, treatment_time - 0.25)) %>%
  generate_control()

sc_ca %>% plot_trends() +
  labs(title = "Synthetic Control: FFSU Share (California)",
       y = "FFSU Share", x = "Quarter")
sc_ca %>% plot_differences() +
  labs(title = "Synthetic Control: FFSU Share Difference (CA − Synthetic)",
       y = "FFSU Share", x = "Quarter")
sc_ca %>% plot_placebos() +
  labs(title = "Synthetic Control Placebos: FFSU Share",
       y = "FFSU Share", x = "Quarter")
sc_ca %>% plot_mspe_ratio() +
  labs(title = "Synthetic Control: MSPE Ratio (FFSU Share)")
sc_ca %>% grab_unit_weights() %>% arrange(desc(weight))

# SC for Cost per Rx
panel_ca_cost <- panel %>%
  filter(!State %in% contaminated, State != "XX", State != "PR") %>%
  mutate(
    cost_per_rx = total_reimbursed / total_rx,
    ffsu_share = ifelse(is.finite(ffsu_share), ffsu_share, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(cost_per_rx))

n_periods_cost <- n_distinct(panel_ca_cost$qtime)
panel_ca_cost <- panel_ca_cost %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  filter(n() == n_periods_cost) %>%
  ungroup()

sc_ca_cost <- panel_ca_cost %>%
  synthetic_control(
    outcome = cost_per_rx,
    unit = State,
    time = qtime,
    i_unit = "CA",
    i_time = treatment_time,
    generate_placebos = TRUE
  ) %>%
  generate_predictor(
    time_window = c(2015, treatment_time - 0.25),
    cost_per_rx = mean(cost_per_rx, na.rm = TRUE),
    rx_per_enrollee = mean(total_rx / enrollment, na.rm = TRUE),
    ffsu_share = mean(ffsu_share, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  generate_weights(optimization_window = c(2015, treatment_time - 0.25)) %>%
  generate_control()

sc_ca_cost %>% plot_trends() +
  labs(title = "Synthetic Control: Medicaid Cost per Rx (California)",
       y = "Cost per Rx ($, 2024 dollars)", x = "Quarter")
sc_ca_cost %>% plot_differences() +
  labs(title = "Synthetic Control: Cost per Rx Difference (CA − Synthetic)",
       y = "Cost per Rx ($, 2024 dollars)", x = "Quarter")
sc_ca_cost %>% plot_placebos() +
  labs(title = "Synthetic Control Placebos: Cost per Rx",
       y = "Cost per Rx ($, 2024 dollars)", x = "Quarter")
sc_ca_cost %>% plot_mspe_ratio() +
  labs(title = "Synthetic Control: MSPE Ratio (Cost per Rx)")
```

```{r}
# ==================================================================
# 4. DIFFERENCE-IN-DIFFERENCES (DiD) OF CARVE-OUT — CA (Robustness)
# ==================================================================

panel_did_ca <- panel %>%
  filter(!State %in% contaminated, State != "XX", State != "PR") %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.0),
    ffsu_share = ifelse(is.finite(ffsu_share), ffsu_share, 0),
    cost_per_rx = total_reimbursed / total_rx,
    periods_to_treat = as.integer(round((qtime - 2022.0) * 4))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cost_per_rx), is.finite(cost_per_rx))

# DiD regressions
did_ffsu <- feols(ffsu_share ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = panel_did_ca, vcov = ~State)
did_cost <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = panel_did_ca, vcov = ~State)
did_cost_log <- feols(log(cost_per_rx) ~ treated:post | State + qtime,
                      data = panel_did_ca %>% filter(cost_per_rx > 0),
                      vcov = ~State)
summary(did_cost_log)
summary(did_ffsu)
summary(did_cost)

# Event studies
es_ffsu <- feols(ffsu_share ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                 data = panel_did_ca, vcov = ~State)
es_cost <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                 data = panel_did_ca, vcov = ~State)

iplot(es_ffsu, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Event Study: FFSU Share (California)")
iplot(es_cost, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Event Study: Cost per Rx (California)")

```

```{r}
# ===========================================
# 5. DOWNSTREAM EFFECTS OF CARVE-OUT - CA
# ===========================================

# Utilization effect
es_rx <- feols(rx_per_enrollee ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
               data = panel_did_ca %>% filter(!is.na(rx_per_enrollee)), vcov = ~State)
iplot(es_rx, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Event Study: Rx per Enrollee (California)")

# Total reimbursement per enrollee
es_reimb <- feols(reimbursed_per_enrollee ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                  data = panel_did_ca %>% filter(!is.na(reimbursed_per_enrollee)), vcov = ~State)
iplot(es_reimb, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Event Study: Reimbursement per Enrollee (California)")

# Units per prescription
panel_did_ca <- panel_did_ca %>%
  mutate(units_per_rx = total_units / total_rx)
es_units <- feols(units_per_rx ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                  data = panel_did_ca %>% filter(is.finite(units_per_rx)), vcov = ~State)
iplot(es_units, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Event Study: Units per Rx (California)")

# Cost per unit — controls for days supply / quantity changes
panel_did_ca <- panel_did_ca %>%
  mutate(cost_per_unit = total_reimbursed / total_units)

did_cost_unit <- feols(cost_per_unit ~ treated:post | State + qtime,
                       data = panel_did_ca %>% filter(is.finite(cost_per_unit)),
                       vcov = ~State)
summary(did_cost_unit)

es_cost_unit <- feols(cost_per_unit ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                      data = panel_did_ca %>% filter(is.finite(cost_per_unit)),
                      vcov = ~State)
iplot(es_cost_unit, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Event Study: Cost per Unit (California)")

# DiD point estimates
did_rx <- feols(rx_per_enrollee ~ treated:post | State + qtime,
                data = panel_did_ca %>% filter(!is.na(rx_per_enrollee)), vcov = ~State)
did_reimb <- feols(reimbursed_per_enrollee ~ treated:post | State + qtime,
                   data = panel_did_ca %>% filter(!is.na(reimbursed_per_enrollee)), vcov = ~State)
did_units <- feols(units_per_rx ~ treated:post | State + qtime,
                   data = panel_did_ca %>% filter(is.finite(units_per_rx)), vcov = ~State)


summary(did_rx)
summary(did_reimb)
summary(did_units)

# --- Exploratory: Raw trends ---

trend_ca <- panel_did_ca %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(treated == 1, "California", "Control States")) %>%
  group_by(group, qtime) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cost = mean(cost_per_rx, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rx = mean(rx_per_enrollee, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_reimb = mean(reimbursed_per_enrollee, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(trend_ca, aes(x = qtime, y = mean_cost, color = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Cost per Rx: California vs Control States",
       x = "Quarter", y = "Cost per Rx ($)", color = "") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(trend_ca, aes(x = qtime, y = mean_rx, color = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Rx per Enrollee: California vs Control States",
       x = "Quarter", y = "Rx per Enrollee", color = "") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# ======================================================
# 7. DiD FOR SINGLE PBM MODEL — OH's Alternative Reform
# ======================================================

# Ohio implemented a Single PBM (Gainwell) across all MCOs in 2022
# This is NOT a carve-out — pharmacies stay in managed care, but all MCOs use the same PBM with a uniform preferred drug list.

panel_oh <- panel %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WI", "ND", "CA", "NY", "WV", "XX", "PR")) %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(State == "OH"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.75),
    cost_per_rx = total_reimbursed / total_rx,
    periods_to_treat = round((qtime - 2022.75) * 4)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(cost_per_rx))

# DiD
did_oh_cost <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = panel_oh, vcov = ~State)
did_oh_rx <- feols(rx_per_enrollee ~ treated:post | State + qtime,
                   data = panel_oh %>% filter(!is.na(rx_per_enrollee)), vcov = ~State)
did_oh_reimb <- feols(reimbursed_per_enrollee ~ treated:post | State + qtime,
                      data = panel_oh %>% filter(!is.na(reimbursed_per_enrollee)), vcov = ~State)
summary(did_oh_cost)
summary(did_oh_rx)
summary(did_oh_reimb)

# Event studies
es_oh_cost <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                    data = panel_oh, vcov = ~State)
iplot(es_oh_cost, xlab = "Quarters relative to OH SPBM launch",
      main = "Event Study: Cost per Rx (Ohio SPBM)")

es_oh_rx <- feols(rx_per_enrollee ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                  data = panel_oh %>% filter(!is.na(rx_per_enrollee)), vcov = ~State)
iplot(es_oh_rx, xlab = "Quarters relative to OH SPBM launch",
      main = "Event Study: Rx per Enrollee (Ohio SPBM)")

# Compare reform types between CA carve-out and OH SPBM 
cat("\n=== REFORM TYPE COMPARISON ===\n")
cat("CA Full Carve-Out — Cost per Rx:", round(coef(did_cost), 2), "\n")
cat("OH Single PBM     — Cost per Rx:", round(coef(did_oh_cost), 2), "\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================
# 8. NADAC SPREAD ANALYSIS — PBM Transparency
# =============================================

# Load all NADAC files, get quarterly average NADAC per NDC
process_nadac <- function(file) {
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    clean_names() %>%
    mutate(
      eff_date = as.Date(effective_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
      Year = as.integer(format(eff_date, "%Y")),
      Quarter = ceiling(as.integer(format(eff_date, "%m")) / 3),
      qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4,
      NDC = sprintf("%011.0f", as.numeric(ndc))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(qtime)) %>%
    group_by(NDC, qtime, classification_for_rate_setting) %>%
    summarise(
      nadac_per_unit = mean(nadac_per_unit, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

nadac_files <- paste0("NADAC/nadac-national-average-drug-acquisition-cost-",
                      2015:2025, ".csv")
nadac_all <- bind_rows(lapply(nadac_files, process_nadac))

# Load SDUD at NDC level — process one year at a time to save memory
process_ndc <- function(file) {
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(State != "XX") %>%
    mutate(
      qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4,
      NDC = sprintf("%011.0f", as.numeric(NDC)),
      `Units Reimbursed` = as.numeric(`Units Reimbursed`),
      `Total Amount Reimbursed` = as.numeric(`Total Amount Reimbursed`),
      `Number of Prescriptions` = as.numeric(`Number of Prescriptions`)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Units Reimbursed`), `Units Reimbursed` > 0) %>%
    group_by(State, NDC, qtime) %>%
    summarise(
      units = sum(`Units Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      reimbursed = sum(`Total Amount Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      rx = sum(`Number of Prescriptions`, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

sdud_files <- paste0("SDUD/StateDrugUtilizationData-", 2015:2025, ".csv")
ndc_panel <- bind_rows(lapply(sdud_files, process_ndc))

# Join SDUD to NADAC by NDC and quarter
ndc_spread <- ndc_panel %>%
  inner_join(nadac_all, by = c("NDC", "qtime")) %>%
  mutate(
    reimbursed_per_unit = reimbursed / units,
    spread = reimbursed_per_unit - nadac_per_unit,
    spread_pct = spread / nadac_per_unit * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(spread_pct),
       spread_pct > quantile(spread_pct, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
       spread_pct < quantile(spread_pct, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))

# --- CROSS-SECTIONAL: CA vs managed care states ---

other_carveout <- c("NY", "WV", "MO", "TN", "WI", "ND")

spread_by_type_clean <- ndc_spread %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("XX", "PR")) %>%
  mutate(
    state_type = case_when(
      State == "CA" ~ "CA (Carved Out)",
      State %in% other_carveout ~ "Other Carved Out",
      TRUE ~ "Managed Care (Carved In)"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(state_type, qtime) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spread = weighted.mean(spread, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot spread over time by state type
ggplot(spread_by_type_clean, aes(x = qtime, y = mean_spread, color = state_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Reimbursement Spread Above NADAC Over Time",
       x = "Time", y = "Mean Spread ($ per unit)",
       color = "State Type") +
  theme_minimal()

# Brand vs generic spread over time 
brand_spread_time <- ndc_spread %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("XX", "PR")) %>%
  mutate(
    drug_type = ifelse(classification_for_rate_setting == "G", "Generic", "Brand"),
    state_type = case_when(
      State == "CA" ~ "CA (Carved Out)",
      State %in% other_carveout ~ "Other Carved Out",
      TRUE ~ "Managed Care (Carved In)"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(state_type, drug_type, qtime) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spread = weighted.mean(spread, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(brand_spread_time, aes(x = qtime, y = mean_spread, color = state_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~drug_type, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Reimbursement Spread Above NADAC: Brand vs Generic",
       x = "Time", y = "Mean Spread ($ per unit)",
       color = "State Type") +
  theme_minimal()

# --- DiD on spread: did CA's spread change post-carve-out? ---
state_spread_panel <- ndc_spread %>%
  group_by(State, qtime) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spread = weighted.mean(spread, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_spread_pct = weighted.mean(spread_pct, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WI", "ND", "OH", "NY", "WV", "XX", "PR")) %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.0),
    periods_to_treat = round((qtime - 2022.0) * 4)
  )

did_spread <- feols(mean_spread ~ treated:post | State + qtime,
                    data = state_spread_panel, vcov = ~State)
summary(did_spread)

es_spread <- feols(mean_spread ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                   data = state_spread_panel, vcov = ~State)
iplot(es_spread, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Event Study: Reimbursement Spread Above NADAC (California)")

# State-level spread summary (post-carve-out only)
state_spread_post <- ndc_spread %>%
  filter(qtime >= 2022.0) %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spread = weighted.mean(spread, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_spread_pct = weighted.mean(spread_pct, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_excess = sum(spread * units, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6,  # in millions
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_spread)

cat("\nPost-Carve-Out State Spread Summary (sorted by spread):\n")
print(state_spread_post, n = 55)

# --- DiD on NADAC spread by brand vs generic ---

state_spread_bg <- ndc_spread %>%
  mutate(drug_type = ifelse(classification_for_rate_setting == "G", "Generic", "Brand")) %>%
  group_by(State, qtime, drug_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spread = weighted.mean(spread, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WI", "ND", "OH", "NY", "WV", "XX", "PR")) %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.0),
    periods_to_treat = round((qtime - 2022.0) * 4)
  )

for (dt in c("Generic", "Brand")) {
  d <- state_spread_bg %>% filter(drug_type == dt)
  
  did <- feols(mean_spread ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = d, vcov = ~State)
  cat("\n=== CA NADAC Spread —", dt, "===\n")
  print(summary(did))
  
  es <- feols(mean_spread ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
              data = d, vcov = ~State)
  iplot(es, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
        main = paste("Event Study: NADAC Spread —", dt, "(California)"))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 9. GENERIC VS BRAND STRATIFICATION
# ============================================

# Get brand/generic classification from NADAC
brand_flag <- nadac_all %>%
  distinct(NDC, classification_for_rate_setting) %>%
  group_by(NDC) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Merge into NDC-level SDUD panel
# Note: prevent inner dropping of specialty drugs that do not have NADAC prices 
ndc_panel_typed <- ndc_panel %>%
  left_join(brand_flag, by = "NDC") %>%
  mutate(drug_type = case_when(
    classification_for_rate_setting == "G" ~ "Generic",
    classification_for_rate_setting %in% c("B", "N") ~ "Brand",
    TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
  ))

# Aggregate to state-quarter by drug type
brand_generic_panel <- ndc_panel_typed %>%
  group_by(State, qtime, drug_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_rx = sum(rx, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_reimbursed = sum(reimbursed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(enrollment_q, by = c("State", "qtime")) %>%
  mutate(
    cost_per_rx = total_reimbursed / total_rx,
    rx_per_enrollee = total_rx / enrollment,
    reimbursed_per_enrollee = total_reimbursed / enrollment
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(cost_per_rx), !is.na(rx_per_enrollee))

# --- CA DiD by drug type ---
bg_ca <- brand_generic_panel %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WI", "ND", "OH", "NY", "WV", "XX", "PR")) %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.0),
    periods_to_treat = round((qtime - 2022.0) * 4)
  )

bg_results <- list()

for (dt in c("Generic", "Brand")) {
  d <- bg_ca %>% filter(drug_type == dt)
  
  bg_results[[paste0("ca_", tolower(dt), "_cost")]] <- feols(
    cost_per_rx ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = d, vcov = ~State)
  cat("\n=== CA", dt, "— Cost per Rx ===\n")
  print(summary(bg_results[[paste0("ca_", tolower(dt), "_cost")]]))
  
  bg_results[[paste0("ca_", tolower(dt), "_rx")]] <- feols(
    rx_per_enrollee ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = d, vcov = ~State)
  cat("\n=== CA", dt, "— Rx per Enrollee ===\n")
  print(summary(bg_results[[paste0("ca_", tolower(dt), "_rx")]]))
  
  es <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
              data = d, vcov = ~State)
  iplot(es, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
        main = paste("Event Study: Cost per Rx —", dt, "(California)"))
  
  es_u <- feols(rx_per_enrollee ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                data = d, vcov = ~State)
  iplot(es_u, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
        main = paste("Event Study: Rx per Enrollee —", dt, "(California)"))
}
```

```{r}
panel_stag <- panel %>%
  filter(State != "XX", State != "PR",
         !State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WI", "ND", "OH")) %>%
  mutate(
    treat_time = case_when(
      State == "WV" ~ 2017.5,
      State == "CA" ~ 2022.0,

    ),

    treat_q_idx = round(treat_time * 4)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(cost_per_rx))

# Staggered event studies using integer indices

                      data = panel_stag, vcov = ~State)

      main = "Staggered Event Study: FFSU Share (WV + CA + NY)")
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 11. MEDICARE PART D - Placebo Test

partd_files <- list.files("Medicare_Part_D_Prescribers_Geography_Drug",
                          pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

process_partd <- function(file) {
  year <- as.numeric(gsub(".*DY(\\d{2}).*", "\\1", basename(file))) + 2000
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(Prscrbr_Geo_Lvl == "State") %>%
    group_by(State = Prscrbr_Geo_Cd) %>%
    summarise(
      partd_claims = sum(Tot_Clms, na.rm = TRUE),
      partd_cost = sum(Tot_Drug_Cst, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Year = year)
}

partd_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(partd_files, process_partd))

fips_to_state <- data.frame(
  fips = sprintf("%02d", c(1:2,4:6,8:13,15:42,44:51,53:56)),
  State = c("AL","AK","AZ","AR","CA","CO","CT","DE","DC","FL",
            "GA","HI","ID","IL","IN","IA","KS","KY","LA","ME",
            "MD","MA","MI","MN","MS","MO","MT","NE","NV","NH",
            "NJ","NM","NY","NC","ND","OH","OK","OR","PA","RI",
            "SC","SD","TN","TX","UT","VT","VA","WA","WV","WI","WY")
)

partd_raw <- partd_raw %>%
  mutate(State = sprintf("%02d", as.numeric(State)))

partd_raw <- partd_raw %>%
  left_join(fips_to_state, by = c("State" = "fips")) %>%
  select(-State) %>%
  rename(State = State.y)

partd_panel <- partd_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(State)) %>%
  mutate(
    cost_per_claim = partd_cost / partd_claims,
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(Year >= 2022),
    periods_to_treat = Year - 2022
  ) %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WV", "WI", "ND", "OH", "NY", "XX", "PR"))

did_partd <- feols(cost_per_claim ~ treated:post | State + Year, data = partd_panel)
summary(did_partd)

es_partd <- feols(cost_per_claim ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + Year,
                  data = partd_panel)
iplot(es_partd, xlab = "Years relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Placebo: Part D Cost per Claim (California)")
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 12. DRUG CLASS HETEROGENEITY 
# ============================================

process_file_drugs <- function(file) {
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(State != "XX") %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Product Name`)) %>%
    mutate(
      qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4,
      `Number of Prescriptions` = as.numeric(`Number of Prescriptions`),
      `Total Amount Reimbursed` = as.numeric(`Total Amount Reimbursed`),
      drug_class = case_when(
        grepl("METFORMIN|INSULIN|GLIPIZIDE|GLYBURIDE|JARDIANCE|FARXIGA|OZEMPIC|TRULICIT",
        `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Antidiabetic",
        grepl("LISINOPRI|AMLODIPIN|LOSARTAN|METOPROLO|ATENOLOL|HYDROCHL",
        `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Antihypertensive",
        grepl("ATORVAST|SIMVAST|ROSUVAST|LIPITOR|CRESTOR|ZOCOR",
        `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) & 
          !grepl("NYSTATIN|SPRAVATO", `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Statin",
        grepl("SERTRALIN|FLUOXETIN|ESCITALOP|CITALOPRA|VENLAFAXI|DULOXETIN|BUPROPION",
        `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Antidepressant",
        grepl("RISPER|QUETIAPINE|OLANZAPIN|ARIPIPR|CLOZAPINE|ZIPRAS",
        `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Antipsychotic",
        grepl("EMTRICIT|TENOFOVIR|BIKTARVY|DESCOVY|TRUVADA|DOVATO|TRIUMEQ",
        `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "HIV Antiretroviral",
        grepl("LENALIDO|REVLIMID|IMATINIB|GLEEVEC|IBRUTINI|IMBRUVIC|CAPECITA|XELODA|TAMOXIFE|LETROZOL|ANASTRO|ENZALUT|XTANDI|ABIRATE",
        `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Oncology",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
        ) 
    ) %>%
    filter(drug_class != "Other") %>%
    group_by(State, qtime, drug_class) %>%
    summarise(
      rx = sum(`Number of Prescriptions`, na.rm = TRUE),
      reimbursed = sum(`Total Amount Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

sdud_files <- paste0("SDUD/StateDrugUtilizationData-", 2015:2025, ".csv")
drugs_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(sdud_files, process_file_drugs))

# Merge enrollment
drugs_panel <- drugs_raw %>%
  left_join(enrollment_q, by = c("State", "qtime")) %>%
  mutate(
    rx_per_enrollee = rx / enrollment,
    cost_per_rx = reimbursed / rx
  ) %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WI", "ND", "OH", "NY", "WV", "XX", "PR"),
         !is.na(rx_per_enrollee), is.finite(cost_per_rx)) %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.0),
    periods_to_treat = round((qtime - 2022.0) * 4)
  )

# Fill missing state-quarter-drug combinations with zeros
drugs_panel <- drugs_panel %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    State, qtime, drug_class,
    fill = list(rx = 0, reimbursed = 0, rx_per_enrollee = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(cost_per_rx = ifelse(rx > 0, reimbursed / rx, NA))

# DiD by drug class
drug_classes <- unique(drugs_panel$drug_class)
util_results <- list()
cost_results <- list()

for (dc in drug_classes) {
  d <- drugs_panel %>% filter(drug_class == dc)
  
  did_u <- feols(rx_per_enrollee ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = d, vcov = ~State)
  util_results[[dc]] <- data.frame(
    Drug_Class = dc,
    Outcome = "Rx per Enrollee",
    Estimate = round(coef(did_u), 4),
    SE = round(se(did_u), 4),
    P_value = round(pvalue(did_u), 4)
  )
  cat("\n===", dc, "— Rx per Enrollee ===\n")
  print(summary(did_u))
  
  did_c <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = d, vcov = ~State)
  cost_results[[dc]] <- data.frame(
    Drug_Class = dc,
    Outcome = "Cost per Rx",
    Estimate = round(coef(did_c), 2),
    SE = round(se(did_c), 2),
    P_value = round(pvalue(did_c), 4)
  )
  cat("\n===", dc, "— Cost per Rx ===\n")
  print(summary(did_c))
}

# Combined results table
drug_results <- bind_rows(bind_rows(util_results), bind_rows(cost_results)) %>%
  mutate(
    Sig = case_when(
      P_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      P_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
print(drug_results, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 15. EVENT STUDIES - Specific Oncology Drugs 
# ============================================

# Re-process SDUD keeping individual drug names for oncology
process_onc_drugs <- function(file) {
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(State != "XX") %>%
    mutate(
      qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4,
      `Number of Prescriptions` = as.numeric(`Number of Prescriptions`),
      `Total Amount Reimbursed` = as.numeric(`Total Amount Reimbursed`),
      drug_name = case_when(
        grepl("TAMOXIFE", `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Tamoxifen",
        grepl("CAPECITA|XELODA", `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Capecitabine",
        grepl("IMATINIB|GLEEVEC", `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Imatinib",
        grepl("LENALIDO|REVLIMID", `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Lenalidomide",
        grepl("IBRUTINI|IMBRUVIC", `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Ibrutinib",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(drug_name)) %>%
    group_by(State, qtime, drug_name) %>%
    summarise(
      rx = sum(`Number of Prescriptions`, na.rm = TRUE),
      reimbursed = sum(`Total Amount Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

sdud_files <- paste0("SDUD/StateDrugUtilizationData-", 2015:2025, ".csv")
onc_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(sdud_files, process_onc_drugs))

onc_panel <- onc_raw %>%
  left_join(enrollment_q, by = c("State", "qtime")) %>%
  mutate(
    rx_per_enrollee = rx / enrollment,
    cost_per_rx = reimbursed / rx
  ) %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WI", "ND", "OH", "NY", "WV", "XX", "PR"),
         !is.na(rx_per_enrollee), is.finite(cost_per_rx)) %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.0),
    periods_to_treat = round((qtime - 2022.0) * 4)
  )

# Fill missing state-quarter-drug combinations with zeros
onc_panel <- onc_panel %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    State, qtime, drug_name,
    fill = list(rx = 0, reimbursed = 0, rx_per_enrollee = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cost_per_rx = ifelse(rx > 0, reimbursed / rx, NA),
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.0),
    periods_to_treat = round((qtime - 2022.0) * 4)
  )

# DiD and event studies for each drug
for (drug in unique(onc_panel$drug_name)) {
  d <- onc_panel %>% filter(drug_name == drug)
  
  # Skip if too few observations
  n_ca_pre <- sum(d$State == "CA" & d$qtime < 2022.0)
  n_ca_post <- sum(d$State == "CA" & d$qtime >= 2022.0)
  if (n_ca_pre < 10 | n_ca_post < 5) next
  
  did_c <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = d, vcov = ~State)
  cat("\n===", drug, "— Medicaid Cost per Rx ===\n")
  print(summary(did_c))
  
  did_u <- feols(rx_per_enrollee ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = d, vcov = ~State)
  cat("\n===", drug, "— Rx per Enrollee ===\n")
  print(summary(did_u))
  
  es <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
              data = d, vcov = ~State)
  iplot(es, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
        main = paste("Event Study:", drug, "Medicaid Cost per Rx (California)"))
  
  es_u <- feols(rx_per_enrollee ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                data = d, vcov = ~State)
  iplot(es_u, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
        main = paste("Event Study:", drug, "Rx per Enrollee (California)"))
}
```
